h1: The 7 Best Cordless Stick Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Cordless Stick Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven cordless stick vacuums from Shark and value brands, compared on listed run time, wattage and price tier.
summary: The Shark PowerPro Flex Reveal Plus is our best overall pick, with a listed 50 minute run time in the $100 to $200 bucket. The JELLYPIG, Uosogi and SMOTURE stick vacuums list 70 minutes and 650W for the same bucket, while the KARDV is the cheapest here at 60 minutes and 500W.
intro: The usual cordless vacuum mistake is reading a big run time as a promise for every cleaning mode. Listed minutes are normally the longest figure, so a vacuum advertised at 70 minutes can run for far less when you use its strongest setting.
We reviewed seven cordless stick vacuums on paper, comparing listed run time, wattage and price bucket. Two Shark Pet listings share a name, so we counted that model once.

products.name: Shark PowerPro Flex Reveal Plus Cordless Vacuum
products.verdict: The best-known brand with a 50 minute run time in the mid bucket.
products.description:
The Shark PowerPro Flex Reveal Plus is cordless and lists a 50 minute run time, in the $100 to $200 bucket.

It leads because it pairs a long run time with a major brand at a mid price. The value brands below list more minutes, but this is the one with an established name behind it.

Buy it if brand support matters. Skip it if you want the longest listed run time.
cons: Less run time than value brands
products.idealFor: Buyers who prefer a major brand.
products.skipIf: You want the longest listed run time.

products.name: JELLYPIG Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
products.verdict: 70 minutes and 650W listed, from a value brand.
products.description:
The JELLYPIG lists a 70 minute run time and 650W of power, cordless, in the $100 to $200 bucket.

Second place reflects that it offers more minutes and watts than the Shark, but from a less established brand.

Pick it for the headline numbers. Skip it if brand support is a priority.
cons: Max run time likely uses low mode

products.name: Uosogi Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
products.verdict: Same listed 70 minutes and 650W as JELLYPIG.
products.description:
The Uosogi lists 70 minutes of run time and 650W, cordless, in the $100 to $200 bucket.

Third spot comes down to the fact that its listed numbers match the JELLYPIG and the facts give no tiebreaker. Buy whichever is cheaper on the day.

It suits the same buyer. Skip it if you want a known brand.

products.name: SMOTURE Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
products.verdict: Another 70 minute, 650W cordless in the same bucket.
products.description:
The SMOTURE lists 70 minutes and 650W, cordless, in the $100 to $200 bucket.

Fourth position follows from the fact that it is a third near twin of the JELLYPIG and Uosogi, with nothing in the facts to separate them.

It works as a price comparison pick. Skip it if you want a more differentiated model.

products.name: KARDV Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
products.verdict: The lowest price tier here with 60 minutes and 500W listed.
products.description:
The KARDV lists a 60 minute run time and 500W, cordless, in the $50 to $100 bucket.

Fifth place is explained by the fact that it lists fewer minutes and watts than the 650W models, but it sits a full price tier lower.

Choose it for the lowest outlay. Skip it if you want the most power.

products.name: Shark Pet Cordless Stick Vacuum
products.verdict: A Shark with a 40 minute listed run time.
products.description:
The Shark Pet Cordless Stick lists a 40 minute run time, in the $100 to $200 bucket.

Sixth place is down to the fact that 40 minutes is shorter than the other picks. A second listing with the same name sits in the $200 to $500 bucket, so check which one you open.

It suits smaller homes that want a Shark. Skip it for large floors.

products.name: Shark Cordless Vacuum Cleaner - Blue - IZ363HT
products.verdict: A 50 minute Shark in the highest price bucket here.
products.description:
The Shark IZ363HT lists a 50 minute run time, cordless, in the $200 to $500 bucket.

Last spot reflects that it matches the cheaper PowerPro on listed minutes while costing a full tier more.

Choose it if you specifically want this model. Skip it if you want value.
cons: Same run time as cheaper Shark
products.idealFor: Fans of this specific Shark model.

whatMatters.detail: Run time is how long one charge lasts, usually at the lowest power. It matters because high power modes drain the battery faster. Look for the minutes figure and assume it is best case.
Wattage is a rough sign of motor power, though it does not translate directly into suction. Compare it only among similar models. Check the listing for the number.
A known brand typically offers easier access to parts and service. Value brands may not. Check the seller listing for warranty details.
Higher tiers do not always mean more listed run time. Compare minutes per price bucket before deciding.
Some models appear under identical names at different price points. Open the exact listing and compare model numbers.

faq.q: Does the listed run time apply to every mode?
faq.a: No. It is usually the longest figure, at low power.

faq.q: Are the three 650W models the same?
faq.a: Their listed numbers match. The facts give no tiebreaker, so choose by price.

faq.q: Is a Shark worth it over a value brand?
faq.a: If brand support matters, yes. If run time matters most, the value brands list more minutes.

faq.q: How do I check which Shark Pet I am buying?
faq.a: Two listings share the name at different price tiers. Compare model details before ordering.

faq.q: How do I maintain a cordless vacuum?
faq.a: Empty the bin after use and keep the battery charged but not stored at extremes.

faq.q: Can I use these on every floor type?
faq.a: The facts we reviewed do not state floor types. Check each listing.

finalTake: The Shark PowerPro Flex Reveal Plus is the best overall pick for brand support, while the JELLYPIG leads on listed run time. The KARDV is the budget choice. Because several listings are near identical, open the exact page and confirm the model before you buy.
